purpose: Learn and separately validate an old mechanism, undergo an unknown online change, synthesize bounded edits and validate a replacement
guards: Old theory must be learned from public interaction and separately validated
Neither private post-change table, change boundary, case label nor world seed enters the Agent
Charge resets, monitoring, failures, diagnostic discovery and independent validation
Keep control-only explanations in the same competing space
Preserve all finite-horizon behavior and attribution aliases
No silent candidate truncation or acceptance after incomplete search
Freeze whole validation batch before dispatch; never fit this candidate to its validation results
Shadow words and query IDs must be fresh
Public policy and independent raw edit/compile/ledger checks must precede private truth reads
Acceptance certifies conditional reset behavior only, not unique causal structure
analysis: Report all cases, detection delay, attribution errors, prediction recovery, unresolved coverage and total experiment cost
limitations: Development, not a formal statistical preregistration
Two fixed bootstrap templates, no independent structural train/test split
Candidate-dependent shadow action coverage, not an unbiased random test
No full computation-cost, posterior calibration, adaptive-learner or LLM comparison
No H4 transfer, Minecraft/RGB or overall completion claim
